[/size][center][size=5][b]About[/b][/size][/center]
Champagne Wishes Continued is an official conversion of the mod[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5721] Champagne Wishes[/url] by fwippy (aka [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/maerumaer2u/mods?gameId=1303]maerumaer2u[/url]) for Stardew Valley version 1.6. The mod has been rewritten to use the Cornucopia mod family instead of PPJA, and Content Patcher instead of Json Assets, while still maintaining the mod's original function.

So what exactly does this mod add? Well, here's fwippy's original description: 
﻿[quote]A﻿re you in the mood to be [i]fancy[/i]?  This mod adds Champagne Grapes (Year 3+ Spring trellis crop) and the ability to make Champagne and Champagne Vinegar.  Also included are a selection of recipes and cocktails to make use of all this bubbly stuff- with more fancy recipes to come![/quote]﻿
Pretty neat huh? ﻿

It is recommended that you enable the Vinegar Keg configuration from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url] so you can produce your own Champagne Vinegar. 
﻿[size=5][b][center]Changes from the Original[/center][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Champagne Vinegar appears for purchase in the Saloon if the Vinegar Keg config option from Cornucopia - Artisan Machines is disabled [/size]
[*][size=2]Champagne Sorbetto is now made with 1 Champagne + 1 Frozen Tear [/size]
[*][size=2]Champagne Cocktail is now made with 1 Champagne, 1 Flower (any), 1 Wine (any), 1 Sugar, 1 Orange Zest, and 1 Cherry [/size]
[*][size=2]Kir Imperial is now made with 1 Champagne, 1 Raspberry, and 1 Wine (any) [/size]
